{"subject":"Do not submit claim C021628 - duplicate of C002392","body":"Hi billing lead,

Please do not submit claim C021628 (patient PT0255, service S5125, date of service 2026-10-16, billed $129.60). The same member, service and date is already billed as C002392, so this claim duplicates it. The payer, Harbor Medicaid Plan, is predicted to deny it as a duplicate (D05). It also fails the daily unit maximum (D06): 24 units already paid that day plus 24 would exceed the 32-unit limit. Editing the claim cannot fix this, and the units would need to drop from 24 to 8 in any case.

Could you hold this claim and confirm it is removed from the submission queue? The claim is scheduled for submission on 2026-11-20, so please confirm before then.

Thank you."}
